{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts overshoot price when sentiment is positive, especially in early forecast horizons",
    "Model underforecasts price when sentiment turns negative, with increasing lag over time",
    "Sentiment alignment correction: adjust forecasts toward mean when sentiment deviates far from price movement",
    "Price mean-reversion bias: forecasts are too optimistic during uptrends and too pessimistic during downtrends",
    "Sentiment strength correction: weak sentiment signals require larger adjustments to model output",
    "Forecast horizon dependent correction: errors compound faster in longer-term forecasts"
] }
